title: Mold Remediation Sampling: Reuse of Laboratory Results from a Linked Water Job
content:
On a Mold Remediation job, the most recent asbestos sampling line booked on the company Water Damage Mitigation job linked to the mold job decides the standard-set charge of the pre-removal asbestos sampling line.

**Rule.** If that water sampling line is dated no more than 365 days (the results reuse days) before the mold job's opened date, or on or after that opened date, the laboratory results on file are reviewed instead of re-sampling the standard set and the standard-set charge is the results review fee of 85.00. If it is dated more than 365 days before the opened date, the standard-set charge is the confirmation set fee of 210.00. When the mold job has no linked water job, or the linked water job carries no asbestos sampling line, the standard-set charge stays the tier's asbestos sampling fee. The days are counted in calendar days from the water sampling date to the opened date.

## Questions answered by the rule

**Which water sampling line counts?** The most recent asbestos sampling line on the Water Damage Mitigation job the mold job is linked to; earlier sampling lines on that job do not decide the charge.

**Where does the boundary fall?** At 365 calendar days counted from the water sampling date to the mold job's opened date.

| Water sampling line dated (hypothetical) | Standard-set charge |
|---|---|
| 365 days before the opened date | 85.00 (results review) |
| 366 days before the opened date | 210.00 (confirmation set) |
| On the opened date | 85.00 (results review) |
| After the opened date | 85.00 (results review) |
| No asbestos sampling line on the linked water job | The tier's asbestos sampling fee |
| No linked water job | The tier's asbestos sampling fee |

**What does each charge buy?** The results review fee covers reviewing the laboratory results already on file instead of re-sampling the standard drywall, joint compound and texture set; the confirmation set fee applies when those results are older than the 365-day reuse period.
